title: DOJ and Europol take down SocksEscort network tied to crypto fraud
summary: Law enforcement agencies seized 34 domains, 23 servers and froze $3.5 million in crypto linked to SocksEscort, a proxy service that hijacked 369,000 devices.

title: Yield-bearing stablecoins surge as Washington fights over yield
summary: Yield-bearing stablecoins are growing faster than the broader market as US lawmakers remain divided over how crypto yield should be regulated.

title: UK central bank is warming up to stablecoins, but says industry input is lacking
summary: The Bank of England is open to fixes on its proposed stablecoin framework, but one official said it needs better feedback from crypto industry participants.

title: Prediction markets will scale as far as their resolution infrastructure allows
summary: Prediction market volume scales every month, as resolution infrastructure becomes a bottleneck. Opaque outcomes drive capital to headline markets only.

title: Here’s why XRP bulls see an ‘explosive run’ to $2.55 next
summary: XRP’s technical and onchain signals hint at a significant breakout, with bulls eyeing an “explosive” rally toward $2.55.

title: HSBC, Standard Chartered tipped for first Hong Kong stablecoin licenses: Report
summary: Hong Kong is set to issue its first stablecoin issuer licenses, with HSBC and Standard Chartered likely among a “very small number” of initially approved issuers, local media reported.

title: Token2049 postpones Dubai event to 2027 amid regional uncertainty
summary: The crypto conference organizer said tickets will remain valid for the rescheduled April 2027 event, with holders also able to transfer tickets to the Singapore event.

title: Bitcoin ‘passing geopolitical stress test’ as BTC price spikes above $72K
summary: Bitcoin price analysis saw conditions slowly ‘building” to support a breakout as BTC emerged as the strongest macro performer since the Iran conflict began.

title: Sweden probes reported leak of e-government platform source code
summary: Sweden is investigating a reported leak tied to CGI Sverige after hackers claimed they exposed source code from the country’s e-government platform.

title: China’s Alibaba joins stablecoin platform MetaComp’s $35M fundraise
summary: MetaComp’s Pre-A+ funding round, backed by Alibaba and Spark Venture, brings the total capital raised to $35 million, with aims to expand its StableX Network globally.
